page.notes: Margin numbers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 are at the right edge beside rows IV, VIII, XII, XV and XVIII. The numeral in the XI row ("IX") and the XVIIII numeral are doubtful. The numeral column for XIV-XVIII is partly smudged; blank cells are where the printed cell is empty. The final "Imp." at lower right is a catchword-like word beneath the last row and is given as a line.
